verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ٱلْجَتِّيَّةِ». لِبَنِي قُورَحَ. مَزْمُورٌ مَا أَحْلَى مَسَاكِنَكَ يَارَبَّ ٱلْجُنُودِ!
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. How amiable [are] thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, Yahweh of Armies!

verses.ar: تَشْتَاقُ بَلْ تَتُوقُ نَفْسِي إِلَى دِيَارِ ٱلرَّبِّ. قَلْبِي وَلَحْمِي يَهْتِفَانِ بِٱلْإِلَهِ ٱلْحَيِّ.
verses.kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
verses.web: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of Yahweh. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

verses.ar: ٱلْعُصْفُورُ أَيْضًا وَجَدَ بَيْتًا، وَٱلسُّنُونَةُ عُشًّا لِنَفْسِهَا حَيْثُ تَضَعُ أَفْرَاخَهَا، مَذَابِحَكَ يَارَبَّ ٱلْجُنُودِ، مَلِكِي وَإِلَهِي.
verses.kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, [even] thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
verses.web: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Yahweh of Armies, my King, and my God.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلسَّاكِنِينَ فِي بَيْتِكَ، أَبَدًا يُسَبِّحُونَكَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [are] they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
verses.web: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِأُنَاسٍ عِزُّهُمْ بِكَ. طُرُقُ بَيْتِكَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [is] the man whose strength [is] in thee; in whose heart [are] the ways [of them].
verses.web: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

verses.ar: عَابِرِينَ فِي وَادِي ٱلْبُكَاءِ، يُصَيِّرُونَهُ يَنْبُوعًا. أَيْضًا بِبَرَكَاتٍ يُغَطُّونَ مُورَةَ.
verses.kjv: [Who] passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
verses.web: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

verses.ar: يَذْهَبُونَ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ إِلَى قُوَّةٍ. يُرَوْنَ قُدَّامَ ٱللهِ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ.
verses.kjv: They go from strength to strength, [every one of them] in Zion appeareth before God.
verses.web: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

verses.ar: يَارَبُّ إِلَهَ ٱلْجُنُودِ، ٱسْمَعْ صَلَاتِي، وَٱصْغَ يَا إِلَهَ يَعْقُوبَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

verses.ar: يَا مِجَنَّنَا ٱنْظُرْ يَا ٱللهُ، وَٱلْتَفِتْ إِلَى وَجْهِ مَسِيحِكَ.
verses.kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
verses.web: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ يَوْمًا وَاحِدًا فِي دِيَارِكَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَلْفٍ. ٱخْتَرْتُ ٱلْوُقُوفَ عَلَى ٱلْعَتَبَةِ فِي بَيْتِ إِلَهِي عَلَى ٱلسَّكَنِ فِي خِيَامِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ.
verses.kjv: For a day in thy courts [is] better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
verses.web: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ ٱللهَ، شَمْسٌ وَمِجَنٌّ. ٱلرَّبُّ يُعْطِي رَحْمَةً وَمَجْدًا. لَا يَمْنَعُ خَيْرًا عَنِ ٱلسَّالِكِينَ بِٱلْكَمَالِ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD God [is] a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good [thing] will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verses.web: For Yahweh God is a sun and a shield. Yahweh will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

verses.ar: يَارَبَّ ٱلْجُنُودِ، طُوبَى لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلْمُتَّكِلِ عَلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: O LORD of hosts, blessed [is] the man that trusteth in thee.
verses.web: Yahweh of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.
